\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{backgrounds}
\pgfdeclarelayer{fg}
\pgfdeclarelayer{discard}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[black, line width=3pt] (0,0) -- (3,3);
  % fg is not listed yet (PGF reports an error) but is painted: the list at
  % the end of the picture counts.
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{fg}
    \draw[green, line width=3pt] (0,3) -- (3,0);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
    \fill[yellow] (0.5,0.5) rectangle (2.5,2.5);
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
      \fill[orange] (1,1) rectangle (2,2);
    \end{pgfonlayer}
    % Lost: the main layer's box is rebuilt around it.
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{main}
      \fill[purple] (0,0) rectangle (0.5,0.5);
    \end{pgfonlayer}
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{main}
    \draw[cyan, line width=3pt] (0,1.5) -- (3,1.5);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \begin{scope}\pgfsetlayers{main}\end{scope}
  \pgfsetlayers{fg,main,background}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
